speaker: edmund_tilney
text: A prince who is obeyed. A friar who means well. Two children who do not mind their elders, and die of it. I find nothing here that touches the state or any person living.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing, sir?

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Would you have me find something, Master Shakespeare? I can, if you are lonely for it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No, sir. I am not lonely for it.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Then I shall not invent you a fault. The pen has been in my hand this hour and a quarter. It comes down now, and only to sign.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have signed it as it stands.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: As it stands. Your other play keeps within its bounds in Shoreditch, I hear. Let it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Seven shillings, Master Tilney. I have them counted.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Seven shillings is the fee. Leave it by the standish. The paper for Monday will not stack itself.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The office is full of tilt-staves, sir, and of painted paper. We will not keep you from either.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: See the other play stays as I have heard it. Good day, masters.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it to me here, John, before we are on the stair. He has turned away.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Say it, then. He is at his paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have been cut by that man twice. I have never felt so slighted as today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A clean licence is the only kind I can afford. Seven shillings, and I enter it once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it. I heard him. I am not putting the three leaves back because a man was courteous.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Let it means let it. Fifty leaves, signed, and nothing struck.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An hour and a quarter. One signature. The office full of tilt-staves, and the prince of less interest than the paper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday is the Queen's day, and not our book. Today the book is licensed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I dislike the taste of it. I will not mend the play to please the dislike.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are done in this room. The Bell has your carrier. I have a fee to enter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven shillings, a clean leaf, and a slight I will not make into a new cut.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Fifty leaves. Seven shillings. Nothing struck. That is the errand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the errand. As far as the Bell, and not into the other play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not into the other play. Go and find your carrier.
